description: What the interface in the main window may ask of the shell: open a native file or folder picker, listen for the window's drag-and-drop events (dropped file paths), open the folder chooser for a watched folder (which hands the folder to the service and gives the page only a grant id and the folder's name), and drive the library sign-in window (open it with a ticket and an https address, ask it to fetch the PDF it shows, close it, sign out of it, keep or forget its sign-in) and open an https address in the researcher's browser. Nothing else: no file system, shell, HTTP, process, window or path access from the page. The sign-in window itself is granted nothing.
